name: Open Fatturazione Elettronica
description: Italian electronic-invoicing cockpit on top of your Fatture in Cloud account. Lists issued invoices, surfaces what's still outstanding, and flags every overdue payment — then exposes it all as a clean JSON API so a Clawnify agent can chase late payers, reconcile incassi, and issue invoices for you. Rides Fatture in Cloud's SdI-accredited pipeline; never touches the regulated transmission itself.
